_comment: Strategy labels/descriptions (UX copy, not game constants). The actual milestone level gating lives on each enhancement-ladder.json step's milestoneFlags.{conservative,progressive} - this file only names the two strategies the UI lets a user pick between.

conservative.label: Conservative
conservative.description: Only ascend at levels flagged as milestones (see each chain's milestoneFlags.conservative). Slower, but never spends resources outside a guaranteed unlock window.

progressive.label: Progressive
progressive.description: Ascend at any level flagged eligible for incremental progress (see each chain's milestoneFlags.progressive). Faster stat gains, higher resource burn rate.
